description: Build a matrix over registered /api/v1 routes with separate columns for authentication, token ability, tenant ownership, role/policy authorization, secret exposure, host-side execution, audit logging and throttling. Conflating those produces ambiguous results: sites.env.content intentionally uses sites.write rather than commands.run, and organization checks are hand-written per controller rather than policy-driven. Output is the matrix plus one issue per gap; remediation is separate tickets. Include cross-tenant tests for nested resources.
title: API v1 authorization matrix
